meta.name: diff-profile
meta.description: Compare two nyann profiles side-by-side and show what would change. TRIGGER ON: 'diff profiles', 'compare profiles', 'what's different between profiles', 'profile diff', 'diff default vs nextjs', 'compare default and python-cli', 'what would change if I switch profiles', 'show me the difference between profiles', 'how does X profile differ from Y', 'what hooks does X add over Y', 'profile comparison', '/nyann:diff-profile'. Do NOT trigger on "switch profile" / "migrate profile" — those are migrate-profile. Do NOT trigger on "inspect profile" / "what does this profile do" — those are inspect-profile.
